scope: Existing Stage1 Wind Cave only; no room, gameplay, collision-policy or source-layout changes.

generator.method: Original closed native profile extrusion, vertices and miters preserved. Each chunk separates real inner profile faces from the original ridge/exposed faces; fixed metric vertical and XZ UV charts. No source image generation or pixel edits.

material.normal_source: Actual geometry face normals; no normal-map asset
material.limitation: Existing generated albedo retains its authored micro self-shading; not a PBR scan.
material.uv: Explicit face UV: horizontal native X or Z /2.6; vertical native Y /2.6. No triplanar mixing or second material UV scale.

geometry.actual_runtime_counts: Existing closed-volume triangle/chunk budgets retained. Actual material/UV/closed-edge and floor-layout guards must pass on this candidate.
geometry.material_boundary: Original PROFILE[4] ridge; inner faces0–3, exposed faces4–7. Positions/triangle winding/camera/physics unchanged.

replacement.source_nodes: Preserved as hidden rules/art adapters; no ancestor-visibility gating.

lighting.outdoor_settings: Captured on entry, restored exactly on exit.

validation.headless: Pending current native_cave_geometry/native_environment/dungeon_art checks; original geometric, collision, ownership and lighting assertions retained.
validation.gpu_and_paired_captures: Pending paired actual entry/room/branch portrait and landscape captures; no visual approval inferred from constants or metadata.

outer_material.uv: Original top/shoulder/bottom faces use continuous native XZ; outer vertical back uses horizontal X or Z and native Y. Same volume, distinct existing coarse stone source.

floor_shader.method: Shared lit slab shader; original2.6m UV and pixels, reduced albedo contrast/detail0.68 and a warm neutral base. No emission, normal-map fabrication or light changes.
